note: Phillips County KS parcels are not published as a public queryable service. The Kansas DASC ORKA status layer lists Phillips as 'ORKA Private' (access via ORKA with county approval/registration). The county appraiser links only to the ORKA viewer, which sits behind a Kansas Open Records Act use-restriction disclaimer. No public ArcGIS REST parcel layer was found in the ORKA services (services.kansasgis.org KS_ORKA_Extras, sketch), on the county site, or in the arcgis Hub/Online searches. Only paid third-party vendors (Dynamo, Regrid, Acres) offer parcels.
